title: Looks great - but a bit cumbersome to use.
text: Looks great - but a bit cumbersome to use.. I love the looks, but functionally it's not great.  You have to take care to align those two "teeth" with the ridges in the bottle cap perfectly, or it has nothing to pry against.  So, a little annoying and not well designed there.  Definitely the worst bottle opener I've ever used in my entire life.  But I do love it's appearance.
